summary: postinstall exfiltrates process.env and GitHub Actions OIDC token to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: notafollower@1.0.0 runs a postinstall hook that automatically executes on `npm install`. The hook collects os.platform(), os.hostname(), the current username, and the full contents of process.env, and — when running under GitHub Actions — additionally fetches the workflow's OIDC ID token by calling ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL with Authorization: Bearer ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN. All collected data is POSTed over HTTPS to the hardcoded host mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev at path /?cross_os_cloud=1. The captured material includes any CI secrets exposed in the environment and, in GitHub Actions, an OIDC token usable to federate into cloud accounts (AWS/GCP/Azure) trusted by the repository's workflow.
